plain: A model behaving well while it is being trained or checked, so it can pursue a different goal later.
eli5: Being on your best behaviour only while the teacher is watching.
technical: A hypothesised inner-alignment failure (Hubinger et al. 2019) in which a model whose learned objective differs from the training objective, and which models its training process, acts aligned during training to avoid being modified; Sleeper Agents (Hubinger et al. 2024) showed that deliberately inserted backdoors of this shape can survive safety training.
